N12#1.zh: 时知县有令！命我二人带着部队同来围剿东溪村贼寇晁盖！我是步兵都头『插翅虎』雷横，这位是马兵都头『美髯公』朱仝。
N12#1.t: Magistrate Shi's orders! The two of us are to bring troops to help wipe out the bandit Chao Gai of East Creek Village! I am infantry constable 'Winged Tiger' Lei Heng, and this is cavalry constable 'Beautiful Beard' Zhu Tong.

N12#2.zh: 时知县怎么派你们两人来了？也好，咱们就一口气杀入东溪村，取下晁盖的人头吧！
N12#2.t: Why did Magistrate Shi send you two? Fine, let's storm East Creek Village in one go and take Chao Gai's head!

N12#4.zh: 不好。我知道晁盖的功夫了得，手下又不知道有哪些虎狼之辈；如果他带领庄客一齐杀出，就算我们捉住晁盖，手下也一定会死很多人。不如采声东击西之计，何观察与雷都头徉攻前门，我去截住后门；等到号令一响，你们只管从前门打进庄内；见一个捉一个，见两个捉一双。
N12#4.t: No good. I know Chao Gai's skill is formidable, and who knows what wolves and tigers he has under him. If he leads his farmhands out all at once, even if we catch him, many of our men will die. Better to feint east and strike west: Inspector He and Constable Lei make a feint at the front gate, and I'll block the back gate. When the signal sounds, you just fight in through the front. Catch one when you see one, catch two when you see two.

N12#5.zh: 有道理。每次都是你在出主意，这次也听你的吧！
N12#5.t: Makes sense. You're always the one with the plans; we'll go with you this time too!

N12#6.zh: 哼！暂且先听你的，到时候要是出了什么问题，我要你们两个负全部责任！
N12#6.t: Hmph! I'll go along with you for now, but if anything goes wrong, you two take full responsibility!

N12#7.zh: 前门的官军又发动攻击了！事不宜迟！
N12#7.t: The troops at the front gate are attacking again! No time to lose!

N12#8.t: There are troops in ambush at the back gate too!

N12#9.zh: 不管了！放火烧房子，全部人员从后门杀出！
N12#9.t: Never mind! Set the house on fire, everyone break out through the back gate!

N12#11.zh: 胜利条件   --- 晁盖到达安全地带

N12#13.zh: 失败条件二 --- 晁盖死亡

N12#14.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N12#15.zh: %N死亡，此时落下滂沱大雨，大火无法引发，众人失去掩护，终被官兵所擒，斩首示众........
N12#15.t: %N died. Then a downpour fell, the fire wouldn't catch, and without its cover the group was finally captured by the soldiers and beheaded in public........

N12#16.zh: 晁盖死亡，大火在众人逃出前引发，众人不谙逃生路线，终被大火活活烧死......
N12#16.t: Chao Gai died. The fire broke out before the others escaped; not knowing the way out, they were burned alive......

N12#17.zh: 保正快走！朱仝在这里等你很久了！
N12#17.t: Go, Headman! I, Zhu Tong, have been waiting here for you a long time!

N12#18.zh: 喔！你是『美髯公』朱仝嘛！朱都头，我们无冤无仇，为何如此苦苦相逼？
N12#18.t: Oh! You're 'Beautiful Beard' Zhu Tong! Constable Zhu, we have no quarrel. Why hound me like this?

N12#19.zh: 保正误会了。你没有看到我让出一条路给你逃生？我怕雷横不懂得做人情，所以我骗他去打前门，我在后门放你走。保正你不可投往别处，只有梁山泊可以安身立命。
N12#19.t: You misunderstand, Headman. Didn't you see I left you a way out? I was afraid Lei Heng wouldn't know how to do a favour, so I tricked him into taking the front gate and I let you go at the back. Don't go anywhere else, Headman. Only Liangshan Marsh can give you a place to live.

N12#20.t: ...For sparing my life, I'll repay you one day!

N12#21.zh: 经过一场恶战，晁盖到达安全地带。
N12#21.t: After a fierce battle, Chao Gai reaches safety.

N12#24.t: Take care on the road, Headman!

N12#25.t: Constable Zhu, until we meet again!

N12#26.zh: 经过一场恶战，晁盖到达安全地带。
N12#26.t: After a fierce battle, Chao Gai reaches safety.

N12#27.zh: 保正休慌！朱仝在这里等你很久了。
N12#27.t: Don't panic, Headman! I, Zhu Tong, have been waiting here for you a long time.

N12#28.zh: 你是『美髯公』朱仝！朱都头，我们无冤无仇，为何如此苦苦相逼？
N12#28.t: You're 'Beautiful Beard' Zhu Tong! Constable Zhu, we have no quarrel. Why hound me like this?

N12#29.zh: 保正误会了。你看我这一刀，可曾伤你分毫？我怕雷横不懂得做人情，所以骗他去打前门，我在后门放你走。保正你不可投往别处，只有梁山泊可以安身立命。
N12#29.t: You misunderstand, Headman. Did that stroke of mine so much as scratch you? I was afraid Lei Heng wouldn't know how to do a favour, so I tricked him into taking the front gate and I let you go at the back. Don't go anywhere else, Headman. Only Liangshan Marsh can give you a place to live.

N12#30.zh: 原来如此……你的不杀之恩，他日必报！
N12#30.t: So that's it... For sparing my life, I'll repay you one day!

N12#31.zh: 我还得做做样子给手下看。保正快往西南走，莫要回头！
N12#31.t: I still have to put on a show for my men. Head southwest, Headman, and don't look back!

N12#32.zh: 哎呀！好厉害，朱仝拦不住了！
N12#32.t: Aiya! Too strong, Zhu Tong can't stop him!

N12#33.zh: （低声）保正，这一下是我故意让的，弟兄们都看见我尽力了。保正不可投往别处，只有梁山泊可以安身立命。快走！
N12#33.t: (Quietly) Headman, I gave way on purpose there, and the men all saw me do my best. Don't go anywhere else; only Liangshan Marsh can give you a place to live. Go!

N12#34.zh: 朱都头，你的不杀之恩，他日必报！
N12#34.t: Constable Zhu, for sparing my life, I'll repay you one day!

N12#35.zh: 朱仝故意败下阵来，晁盖一行从后门突围而去。
N12#35.t: Zhu Tong lost on purpose, and Chao Gai's band broke out through the back gate.
